name: plan-coverage-check
body: The plan-verify derived-coverage stage: computing the change-set's durable-spec delta from the branch's merge-base and requiring exactly that delta's `implemented-by` code FQNs to be touched by a plan task. Anchored on `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` (the pure scope decision, a function of the delta and the plan tasks), `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.solution_nodes_added_on_branch` (the existing branch-delta computation, expected to be replaced by a merge-base durable-spec-delta unit the plan-writer declares as a planned node), and `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.plan_verify_at` (the wiring that supplies the delta and calls coverage). A narrow owner: it is the component the plan-coverage requirement's spine reaches, so the verify gate's derived solution coverage enforces exactly this change-set's coverage code.
